places.name: Tōtara Park native forest
places.description: Council locally lists kererū, fantail, grey warbler, tūī and kākā. Adjacent Botanic Gardens native-forest route offers a 4 km, about 2-hour loop.
places.access: Use designated public forest paths. The adjoining native forest loop has roots and steps and is not accessible. Check current council and Botanic Gardens track advice.

places.name: Auckland Botanic Gardens
places.description: Free gardens and parking at 102 Hill Road, Manurewa, about 25 km south of central Auckland.
places.access: Official pages disagree on gate opening time (06:30 versus 08:00); avoid hardcoding early access. Visitor centre 08:00–16:30, closed Christmas Day; gardens remain open.

places.name: Miko Café
places.description: Operating café within Auckland Botanic Gardens; suitable linked food option.
places.access: Check current café opening and menu directly. Do not use indexed 2024 menu prices.

places.name: Tiritiri Matangi Island
places.description: DOC describes a restored open island sanctuary with translocated, free-living birds. Separate ferry day, best reserved for 5–7-day variants.
places.access: Ferry published Wednesday–Sunday, popular November–April, book early and confirm exact sailing/weather. Bring food. Biosecurity checks; stay on tracks, no feeding or call playback. Commercial guiding needs a permit. Optional full day only. A reviewed calendar date is required in this draft; confirm dated ferry and weather. No transfer-day scheduling.

places.name: Hamilton Gardens
places.description: Themed Enclosed Gardens include Te Parapara. Outer grounds are a separate free-area option.
places.access: Current page shows enclosed entry 10:00–18:00, last entry 17:30, closed Christmas Day. Under-16s free but require ticket. Confirm seasonal hours.

places.name: Waiwhakareke Natural Heritage Park
places.description: Council public restoration park across from Hamilton Zoo. A useful optional local walk, without inventing a local bird checklist.
places.access: Use designated public tracks and check council park information. No indexed species attached.

places.name: Sanctuary Mountain Maungatautari forest visit
places.description: Restored pest-fenced forest with free-flying birds; operator explicitly lists North Island robin, tomtit, kākā, tūī, hihi, tīeke, fantail and kererū.
places.access: Separate excursion from Hamilton. Guided tour approx 90 minutes, arrive 10 minutes early at 99 Tari Road, Pukeatua. Includes day pass. Sightings not guaranteed; omit kiwi/takahē promises. Separate Hamilton-based excursion, with extra travel to Pukeatua. Not a stop on the town-to-town reference. Reserve its own day.

places.name: Sulphur Bay Wildlife Refuge
places.description: DOC locally supports New Zealand dabchick, banded dotterel and black-billed gull. Free wild-bird lakefront outing accessible from Rotorua CBD.
places.access: Stay on designated paths. Do not approach breeding birds or mark nests. Dogs prohibited. Geothermal ground and wildlife restrictions apply; check current access. Tourism board describes about 2 hours for full path.

places.name: Wingspan National Bird of Prey Centre
places.description: Flight of the Falcon is a falconry and conservation demonstration featuring managed kārearea, not a wild sighting.
places.access: Tuesday–Sunday 11:00–13:00; 11:30 show, arrive by 11:00 recommended. 1334 Paradise Valley Road. Advance booking and current biosecurity notices should be checked.

places.name: Te Puia
places.description: Guided daytime Māori arts, crafts and geothermal visit at 20 Hemo Road. Kiwi Conservation Centre is managed, and is not included in wild-bird matches.
places.access: Open 08:45–17:00 daily; last tour 16:00. Check in 15 minutes before tour. Day visits guided. Ticket required; accessible routes and wheelchairs described by operator.

places.name: Pātaka Kai Restaurant, Bar & Café
places.description: Te Puia operator lists daily public lunch/dinner and hāngī buffet options, including labelled vegetarian/vegan menu choices.
places.access: Use main Te Puia entrance. Reserve current sitting and confirm dietary needs; no current price asserted.

places.name: Polynesian Spa Deluxe Lake Spa
places.description: Lakefront hot-mineral-pool bathing, with towels and lockers included; seated immersion rather than swimming.
places.access: Recommended visit about 2 hours. Under-8s need in-water adult supervision. Check exact admission/booking hours directly. No medical-benefit claims.

places.name: Redwood Memorial Grove ground track
places.description: Free 2 km ground-level forest loop, with a published 30-minute walking reference. Paid Redwoods Treewalk is a separate product.
places.access: Use the signposted Memorial Grove track, rather than assuming the whole forest fits a short visit. Check closures and gate times. No locally verified bird list attached.

visitReference.scope: the 2 km Memorial Grove ground track

places.name: ibis budget Auckland Airport
places.description: Airport-area hotel option for arrival buffer before the fixed Auckland-to-Rotorua corridor.
places.access: Dates, occupancy, room type and cancellation terms require live quote. No price, carbon or B Corp claim.

places.name: Hamilton City Holiday Park
places.description: 14 Ruakura Road; self-contained double cabin sleeps up to two and includes linen. Other cabins and camping exist.
places.access: Official page directs to Book Now for live prices and availability. Unknown dynamic price remains unknown.

places.name: Rotorua Thermal Holiday Park
places.description: Direct operator offers self-contained units, cabins, dorms and campsites. Complimentary hot pools are described as fresh chlorinated water.
places.access: Live quote needed for date/occupancy/unit. Full payment on arrival; operator states no refunds for shortened stays or weather-related changes. Do not repeat conflicting mineral-pool guest review as operator fact.

places.name: InterCity Auckland to Hamilton
places.description: Published coach connection. Check exact stops, dated timetable, fares and luggage. This does not establish transport to birding sites.

places.name: InterCity Rotorua services
places.description: Published Rotorua coach services from Auckland and Hamilton. Check current timetable, fares and local onward transport.

places.name: Te Whare Taonga o Waikato Museum & Gallery
places.description: Indoor galleries in central Hamilton. General admission is free; Exscite and some exhibitions or activities have separate fees.
places.access: 1 Grantham Street. Published hours 10:00 to 17:00 daily except 25 December. Review exhibitions, access and current hours. No visit duration or weather-safe journey is assumed.
places.when: Closed 25 December. Indoor alternative is an AVES planning suggestion, not a live weather recommendation.
